entities.summary: Geir Lundestad was a Norwegian historian, who served as the director of Norwegian Nobel Institute when Olav Njølstad took over until 2014. In this capacity, he also served as the secretary of Norwegian Nobel Committee. However, he was not a member of committee itself.
